title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
This market refers to the tennis match between Ryo Tabata and Felipe Meligeni Alves in the Florianopolis, originally scheduled for November 24, 2026 at 1:00PM ET.
This market will resolve to “Ryo Tabata” if Ryo Tabata wins set 2. It will resolve to “Felipe Meligeni Alves” if Felipe Meligeni Alves wins set 2.
If the match begins but set 2 is not completed with a winner determined (including the match ending before set 2 is reached), this market will resolve 50-50.
If the match is canceled (not played at all) or play has not begun by December 8, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve 50-50.
Resolution will be based on official Challenger match statistics.

This market may resolve only when the listed period of play has concluded and the result can be definitively determined by the listed resolution source(s).
